summary.title: Payments v2 (PayPal/Braintree API reference)
summary.one_liner: The page is an API reference listing Payments v2 endpoints for authorizing, capturing, reauthorizing, voiding and refunding payments, not the PostgreSQL article suggested by the listing.
keywords: how to refund a payment via api
takeaways: Payments v2 exposes endpoints to authorize, capture, reauthorize and void a payment by authorization ID.
Captured payments can be looked up by capture ID and refunded through a refund endpoint.
find-eligible-methods returns payment methods available for given input parameters.
The Payments API is meant to be used together with the Orders API and PayPal Checkout.
summary.summary: This page is a reference index for the Payments v2 API, listing endpoints grouped under authorizations, captures, find-eligible-methods and refunds. Each entry gives the HTTP method, path and a one-line description, such as capturing an authorized payment or refunding a captured payment. The page text is mostly navigation and endpoint listings, with no code samples or prose explaining design. The URL and listing refer to a PostgreSQL blog article, but the page content does not match that topic.
